turns.question: What was the net revenue in the week starting Monday 5 October 2026, as non-cancelled order amounts placed that week minus returns credited that same week, even when the returned orders were placed earlier?
turns.answer: Net revenue was 190.0 EUR for the seven days from Monday 5 to Sunday 11 October 2026, counting non-cancelled orders placed in that week minus returns recorded in that week (returns counted on their return date, so returns of earlier orders count). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
